speaker: Iris
text: Engineering will own the hotfix, and we only restore full traffic after QA signs off.
text_zh: 工程团队负责 hotfix，只有在 QA 签字确认后，我们才会恢复全部流量。

speaker: Ravi
text: I will coordinate the hotfix implementation with the backend team.
text_zh: 我会和后端团队一起协调 hotfix 的具体落地。

speaker: Nina
text: QA needs to verify the patch before we return the service to full traffic.
text_zh: 在服务恢复全部流量之前，QA 必须先验证补丁。

speaker: Marta
text: Please route any external user announcement through product review first.
text_zh: 任何面对用户的外部公告都必须先经过产品审核。

speaker: Iris
text: One open question is whether all affected users need a compensation notice.
text_zh: 还有一个待确认问题：是否需要向所有受影响用户发送补偿说明。
